question: India lifted a record-extending ________ ICC U19 World Cup title after defeating England in the final at the Sir Vivian Richards Stadium in North Sound, Antigua in February 2022.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**fifth**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India Claims Historic U19 Cricket World Cup Victory (Feb. 2022):
 
• Secured a record-extending **fifth ICC U19 World Cup title**.
 
• India defeated England by four wickets and won the fifth world cup title at the Sir Vivian Richards Stadium, Antigua. 
 
• **Yash Dhull** became the fifth Indian captain to win the world cup title after **Mohammad Kaif, Virat Kohli, Unmukt Chand, and Prithvi Shaw**.
 
• **Raj Angad Bawa** of India was the Player of the Match in the Final.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **U19 Cricket World Cup:**

 
 
• International tournament: Features Under-19 national cricket teams competing for the World Cup title.
 
• Organized by: International Cricket Council (ICC).
 
• Inaugural year: **1982**.
 
• Frequency: Held every **two years**.
 
• Current champions: India (as of February 2022, with a record five titles).
 
• India had previously won the trophy in **2000, 2008, 2012, and 2018**. 
 
• Format: Varies slightly across editions, typically involving group stages and knockout rounds.
 
• Significance: Considered a prestigious platform for young cricketers to showcase talent and gain exposure.
